decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - With appropriate safeguarding conditions the wind turbines would have no harm on the appearance and character of the area or cause harm to neighbouring residents in accordance with policies ENV - N.1.1 (Purposes of including Land in and Objectives for the Use of Land in Green Belt), ENV - N.1.2 (Acceptable Development in the Green Belt), ENV - B.1.1 (New Development), ENV - B.1.2 (High Buildings or Structures Affecting Sensitive Areas), ENV - P.1.5 (Noise Pollution), ENV- P.2.6 (Renewable Energy), and T.4.4 (Road Safety) of the adopted Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 4 - Permission has been granted for the position of the wind turbines for option number 2 only as indicated on the site location plan received 22nd June 2006.
Condition : 5 - The wind turbines shall be dismantled and all debris shall be removed from the site when the turbines are no longer required.
description: Installation of two 15m high wind turbines.
